name: Nexus Absolute Draco Cannon
text:
4+ 'Nexus' Link, Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monsters.
During the turn this card was summoned Monster effects cannot be activated. Once Per Turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 'Nexus' Monster from your GY then target 1 monster with the same Attribute as the banished monster. Destroy the targeted monster. While you have 4 or more 'Nexus' monsters banished this card cannot be targeted by card effect.
